resources.string: Suggestions from this device\'s own measurements

Based on what this app measured in the last 7 days and on what Android itself counted since the last full charge. When you apply a recommendation you choose how firmly the app is limited. Nothing changes until you apply.
Stops in 7 days: %1$d. Restarts afterwards: %2$d. Stopping it over and over costs more than letting it idle.
Days since it was last opened: %1$d. Its part of all measured app power use: %2$d%%.
Not opened for days, yet its part of all measured app power use is %1$d%%.
Days since it was last opened: %1$d. Minutes active in the background per day: %2$d.
Days since it was last opened: %1$d. Still keeps a sensor switched on in the background.
Gentle: standby after 4 hours without use. If it keeps a sensor on, its idle process is ended. Notifications, alarms and sync keep working.
Balanced: also restricts background activity. Urgent push messages still arrive, its own background sync stops.
Strict: also stops the app after 2 hours without use. Nothing arrives until you open it again.
